editorial:
Imagine living in a weird version of the 90s where you can't get rid of a metal collar around your neck until you kiss someone for the first time. That is the wild setup you get here. You follow a shy kid named Wyrm who is way more into dinosaurs than dating. He is just trying to survive school while everyone else is racing to get their collars off. The vibe is a strange mix of a coming-of-age story and a sci-fi dream, making you feel exactly how awkward it is to be a teenager when the whole world is watching your love life.

The acting feels very real, and the weird world they built is actually pretty funny. Some parts move a bit slow, but the payoff is worth it because the story is so unique. If you like movies that feel like a strange indie dream, you will love this one. You should definitely check it out by renting it on Apple TV or grabbing the 4K Blu-ray if you like owning physical copies. It looks great in high definition, so streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video is your best bet for the best experience.
endingExplained: In the end, Wyrm finally finds a connection with another girl who understands his quirks. They share a kiss, which finally triggers the electronic collar to pop off his neck. It is a sweet moment that shows he doesn't have to change who he is to fit in. The movie wraps up by showing that being an outsider is okay, as long as you find your own person to share your world with.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves weird stories about awkward teenagers.
